replacement_reason: Orchestrator round 1: exact-identity manufacturer working family fails the <=1 mm complete overall dimension gate. New native custom geometry replaces the working selection; OEM originals and prior working RFA remain preserved.
axis_convention: X width, Y front-to-back depth, Z vertical height; millimetres.

identity.Description: Custom dimension-correct visualization replacement; see round-1 notes

dimension_basis: Appliance body dimensions; installation flanges/projections may enlarge native envelope.
measurement_scope: All physical geometry in the complete reopened family and floor-face placed instance. No part or projection filter; no auxiliary bounding object.
limitations: Fixed manufacturer model size; exposed finish parameters are flex-tested.
Internal partitions, edge radii, controls and concealed mechanisms are reference-derived visualization approximations.

Default envelope represents the factory appliance without separately supplied customer overlay panels or handles. Panel Finish changes the represented factory front; it does not certify an overlay thickness or panel shop drawing.
